project_title: Plataforma SaaS de Gestão de Cobranças Profissional

dynamic_branding.mechanism: CSS CSS Custom Variables (--primary, --primary-foreground, --ring) and dynamic HSL updates based on selected tenant company settings

layout.sidebar: Collapsible sidebar with tenant branding switcher, quick stats, navigation menu, and user company profile
layout.top_bar: Includes active company branding pill, theme toggle, notification bell, global search for debtors/invoices, and user menu

key_components.name: Dashboard Header & Company Branding Bar
key_components.description: Exhibits selected tenant's logo, company name, NIF, and primary color picker for live application re-skinning.

key_components.name: Financial Overview Cards (KPIs)
key_components.description: Displays Total em Dívida, Valor Recupedado, Dívida Crítica (>30d), Taxa de Sucesso de Cobrança with trend indicators.

key_components.name: Debtor Table (Lista de Devedores)
key_components.description: Filterable and searchable list of pending debts with company/individual name, NIF, total owed, status badges (Green/Yellow/Red/Purple), and direct action trigger.

key_components.name: Ficha de Cobrança (Debtor Detail View)
key_components.description: Deep-dive view showing debtor history, contacts, pending invoices, communication timeline log, and quick trigger action buttons for WhatsApp and Email.

key_components.name: WhatsApp & Email Message Preparation Modals
key_components.description: Modal windows with smart template selector (1st Reminder, Formal Warning, Legal Pre-Notice), pre-filled text with dynamic tags ([Nome], [Valor], [Fatura], [IBAN]), copy-to-clipboard, and external action launcher.

key_components.name: Branding & Company Settings Page
key_components.description: Form to upload/change logo URL, custom primary color hex, company payment details (IBAN, Multibanco Entity/Reference), and default reminder templates.

motion_and_interactions.toasts: sonner notifications for template copy, company settings saved, and message triggers

instructions_to_main_agent.step_1: Configure index.css and tailwind setup to accept dynamic CSS variables or React context state for primary color theme.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_2: Build FastAPI backend endpoints for /api/companies, /api/companies/{id}/branding, /api/debtors, /api/debtors/{id}, /api/templates, and /api/stats.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_3: Build React Multi-company authentication / tenant switch state with local storage persistence.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_4: Implement Financial Dashboard with color-coded overdue aging badges (Verde: 1-15d, Amarelo: 16-30d, Vermelho: 31-60d, Roxo: >60d/Contencioso).
instructions_to_main_agent.step_5: Implement Ficha de Cobrança with detailed debtor data, history timeline, invoice items, and WhatsApp/Email modal triggers.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_6: Implement WhatsApp and Email pre-filled text modal windows with placeholder variable replacement ([Nome], [Valor], [Fatura], [IBAN], [Data Vencimento]).
instructions_to_main_agent.step_7: Ensure all key elements contain data-testid attributes according to standard convention.
instructions_to_main_agent.step_8: Test API endpoints and UI flow thoroughly.
